welcome.title: Welcome 👋
welcome.subtitle: 3 steps to get ready: your company, 2026 e-invoicing, then your first client. Under 2 minutes — the assistant handles the rest.

company.title: Drop your registration document
company.subtitle: Sole trader: your SIRENE notice · Association: Journal Officiel extract. The assistant reads the document and fills in your profile.

einvoicing.title: Enable electronic invoicing
einvoicing.subtitle: Mandatory from 2026. A one-time connection, then everything is automatic.

client.title: You're all set 🎉
client.subtitle: Create your first client — or drive Factur-IA straight from your assistant (ChatGPT, Claude).

subtitle.company: Drop the document or paste its content — the assistant fills everything in.
subtitle.client: Paste the details or drop a document — a signed email is enough.

dropTitle.company: Drop your registration document or any company file
dropTitle.client: Drop a quote, an invoice or a business card

ai.dropHint: PDF, PNG or JPG · max 10 MB

placeholder.company: Paste your registration document content, or describe your company…
placeholder.client: Paste an email, a signature, contact details…

analyzingHint.company: Recognizing legal fields: company name, registration number, VAT…

ai.fileType: Unsupported format. Use PDF, PNG, JPG or WebP.
ai.extractError: Analysis failed. Try again or fill in manually.
ai.noItems: No invoice line detected — specify the service and amount.

einvoicing.title: Electronic invoicing (PDP)
einvoicing.subtitle: Connect your company to the certified Super PDP platform, once.

benefits.compliance: Compliant with the 2026 reform: your Factur-X invoices are sent through a certified PDP.
benefits.receive: Receive and handle your incoming supplier invoices in one place.
benefits.automatic: Lifecycle, e-reporting and payments declared automatically.

einvoicing.laterHint: You can enable it anytime from your settings.

mcp.title: Via Claude or ChatGPT (MCP)
mcp.subtitle: Drive Factur-IA by chat from your AI assistant.
mcp.step2: Add the connector in your assistant:
mcp.step2Sub: Claude — Settings → Connectors · ChatGPT — Settings → Apps & connectors. Paste the URL, that's it — no token to enter.
mcp.step3: Sign in via OAuth with your Factur-IA account in the window that opens.
mcp.step3Sub: Secure access, limited to your account — revocable anytime.
mcp.step4: Ask your assistant, in plain language:

ask.company: "Create my company in Factur-IA: Atelier Quatools, SAS, reg. no. 901 234 567 00018."

mcp.realtime: As soon as it's done in your assistant, this page moves forward automatically.

manual.subtitle: Fill in the fields, you can change everything later.

finish.hint: No rush? You can complete the rest whenever you want.
finish.cta: Finish and go to my dashboard

compliance.title: 2026 compliance
compliance.desc: Factur-X invoices sent via PDP, e-reporting included.

quotes.title: Quote → Invoice
quotes.desc: Convert a quote into an invoice in one click.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.desc: Create invoices, quotes and clients in plain language. It supports you through your steps.

reminders.title: Tracking & reminders
reminders.desc: Dashboard of revenue, unpaid and overdue invoices.

notdo.eyebrow: What Factur-IA does not do for you

accounting.title: Keep your books
accounting.desc: Factur-IA is not your accountant. Bookkeeping and financial statements remain their job.

decide.title: Decide for you
decide.desc: Your tax and social filings (VAT, social contributions) remain your responsibility — check before sending.

legal.title: Guarantee the legal side
legal.desc: AI prepares, you validate. You remain responsible for the accuracy of the billed data.

coffee.title: Make coffee ☕
coffee.desc: For that, do like everyone else: get an intern. ☕

notdo.note: In short: Factur-IA saves you time, but replaces neither your accountant nor your judgment. You stay in control.
